arthurhalls_attendant.text: Welcome to the Hall of Chivalry. Please do not pull a sword out of the stone. It is a real stone and it is cross.
Frederick Glasscock, a London businessman, built these halls in the 1930s and spent a large part of his fortune on them.
There is a Round Table here and dozens of stained glass windows, many by Veronica Whall, showing Arthur's knights and the Grail.
